decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system sits squarely in the firm's core coolant-management portfolio, supports modular system sales, and after two years on the market a large machinery supplier would usually continue developing rather than withdraw it.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge strengthens the firm's filtration and process-media offering and is likely to be retained because it fits the strategy of profitable system and service business.
The coolant nozzles line is a natural cross-sell to the installed base, and the presence of several models makes withdrawal unlikely unless demand were clearly weak.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is somewhat more peripheral than the coolant products, but it remains a sensible adjacent element of the firm's material-flow and production-support portfolio.

The hinged belt chip conveyor is also an adjacent product with some rationalization risk, yet a broad German machinery firm would typically keep it while it complements conveying solutions and customer projects.
